channel.title: HordeLedger blog
channel.description: Market notes from the WoW Forever Horde auction house.

item.title: Seven Leathers Jumped Up to 17x Before Dawn. Most Are Sliding Back
item.description: Heavy Scorpid Scale went from 9s to 80s in an hour and Chimera Leather from 7s to 93s. Earlier jumps like this were all gone within a day.

item.title: Eternal Essence Up 84% in Two Weeks. Illusion Dust Fell 64%
item.description: Greater Eternal Essence hit 3g 47s while Illusion Dust fell to 20s. Top-end enchants like Greater Stats now cost 26% more in materials than a week ago.

item.title: Raw Rockscale Cod Jumped 22x in an Hour. The Shelf Was Worth 1g
item.description: Four cheap items rose 15x to 28x overnight on the Horde auction house. Since Nov 12, 86% of such jumps were back near the old price within a day.

item.title: Rugged Hide Costs 5s. Cured, It Costs 26g. The Gap Is Salt
item.description: Rugged, Thick and Pristine Hide sit at vendor price on the Horde auction house while Cured Rugged Hide costs 26g. The bottleneck is salt.

item.title: Raids Open in 15 Days. Protection Potions Just Fell Up to 86%
item.description: Two weeks before the first raids, Horde raid potions are getting cheaper, not dearer: Greater Nature Protection fell from 4g to 55s 96c in a week.

item.title: Starter Herbs Doubled in a Week While Endgame Herbs Fell
item.description: Peacebloom, Silverleaf, Mageroyal, Earthroot and Briarthorn rose 73-107% in a week on the Horde auction house, while Stranglevine fell 55%.

item.title: The Price Index Went Flat This Week. The Market Under It Did Not
item.description: The Horde price index ended the week at 34.2, where it started. Leveling materials rose 20-45% while newer endgame materials lost more than half.

item.title: Firebloom and Sungrass Tripled at Dawn. Such Spikes Rarely Last a Day
item.description: Four materials jumped 2x to 17x at the 06:43 scan. Of 895 similar spikes this week, 71% were back near the old price within 12 hours. Sell fast or wait.

item.title: Flasks Cost 16g to Brew, and the Margin Is Shrinking by the Day
item.description: Black Lotus at 9g 48s puts a flask at about 16g in materials. Brewing still pays, but Supreme Power's margin fell from 8g to 2g 80s in two days.

item.title: The Blackmaw Hold Gold Exploit: What the Auction House Shows
item.description: Hourly Horde auction house scans across the Blackmaw Hold gold exploit: no price jump. Goods over 10g fell 36% from Nov 13 to 19; Arcanite rose before it went public.

item.title: Blue Dragonscale Fell 98% in Nine Days. Black Still Costs 16x More
item.description: Blue Dragonscale slid from 4g 8s to 7s 85c, close to its 5s vendor price. Green and Worn are already there. Black holds at 1g 30s and sells fastest.

item.title: First Darkmoon Faire: Bear Pelts Tripled, Then Gave It All Back
item.description: Torn Bear Pelt went from 1s 22c to 4s 45c on day two of the first Darkmoon Faire, then back to 1s 20c. Crafted turn-ins never moved.

item.title: Journeyman Crates Up Sevenfold, Artisan Crates Down 99%
item.description: Waylaid Crates and Sealed Writs split by tier this week: low tiers doubled or more on thinner stock, while Artisan supply grew twelvefold and prices collapsed.

item.title: Prices Fell 18% This Week, but Raw Materials Have Stopped
item.description: The Horde price index is down 18% on the week, yet trade goods have been flat for three days. Potions, recipes and gear are still falling.

item.title: Level-50 Blues Are Halving: Wait to Buy, List Fast
item.description: Rare gear for level 48+ on the Horde auction house has lost 38% in two days as listings quadrupled. Why the cheap ones aren't flips yet.

item.title: Smelting Pays More the Higher the Skill Gate
item.description: Thorium Bar clears about 7s over Thorium Ore after the auction cut; copper and tin clear nothing. Smelting margins on the Horde AH, by skill level.

item.title: Five Cheap Staples Repriced Overnight
item.description: Small Venom Sac, Fish Bowl, Elemental Water and two more jumped 3x to 1,900x in one night on the Horde AH. Which moves are holding and which aren't.

item.title: Silk, Heavy Leather and Iron Bar Hit the Vendor Floor
item.description: Iron Bar, Silk Cloth and Heavy Leather are down about 90% since launch and now trade within 20-30% of vendor price: little downside left for crafters.

item.title: The first 72 hours of the Horde auction house
item.description: We watched one WoW Forever auction house from launch night on. Prices halved, ammo ran a third of all volume, and most listings that vanish come straight back cheaper. Ten things that stood out.
